heading: Blueprint first. Code second.
why: We don't write speculative code. Every project goes through discovery and a signed-off structure before development starts.

steps.title: Blueprinting & Scoping
steps.text: Requirements, user flows, data schemas and technical specs, agreed up front.

steps.title: Wireframing & UI Architecture
steps.text: Page layouts, content hierarchy and the design system, drawn in high fidelity.

steps.title: Engineering & CMS Integration
steps.text: Component-based code, plus an editor your team can use.

steps.title: Audit, Security & Launch
steps.text: Browser, accessibility, speed and security checks before anything goes live.
